_comment: 10-task V1 benchmark (Kimi's rubric). iceni benchmark benchmarks/tasks.10-task.json [--execute --judge claude --report report-v1.md]
_rubric: Kimi V1: functional 40% / token 30% / format 15% / semantic 15%. Pass = avg V1 > 70/100.

tasks.name: code-review

intent.goal: Review this code for bugs, edge cases, and security issues.

style_hints.claude: use XML tags with severity attributes
style_hints.gpt: prioritized markdown table with CWE where applicable
style_hints.kimi: terse bullet points grouped by severity

tasks.baseline: Please review the following code very carefully for any and all bugs, edge cases, security vulnerabilities, and potential improvements. For each issue you find, provide a thorough explanation, the severity level, and a concrete suggested fix. Be comprehensive. {{code}}

tasks.name: test-gen

intent.goal: Write unit tests for this function.
constraints: cover edge cases and negative cases
include a fixture if state needed

style_hints.claude: XML-wrapped code block with a brief test strategy note
style_hints.gpt: markdown code block with test case comments
style_hints.kimi: just the code, no extra prose

tasks.baseline: Write a comprehensive and thorough set of unit tests for the following function using pytest. Make sure to cover all the important edge cases, error conditions, and boundary values, and include at least one negative test (expected failure). {{code}}

tasks.name: refactor

intent.goal: Refactor this code for clarity, safety, and maintainability.

outputs.format: refactored code then a brief change summary

style_hints.claude: before/after in XML blocks with change rationale
style_hints.kimi: code first, then one-line per change

tasks.baseline: Refactor the following code to improve its clarity, safety, and maintainability. Preserve all existing behavior but add appropriate type hints, fix any obvious bugs, and briefly explain the key changes you made. {{code}}

tasks.name: docstring

intent.goal: Write a Google-style docstring for this function.

style_hints.claude: Google-style in an XML code block
style_hints.gpt: Google-style in a markdown code block
style_hints.kimi: compact Google docstring, no extra prose

tasks.baseline: Write a comprehensive docstring for the following function in Google style. Include: a one-line summary, an Args section with types and descriptions, a Returns section, and a Raises section if applicable. Note any known issues or bugs. {{code}}

tasks.name: error-explain

intent.goal: Explain this Python error and give the exact fix.
constraints: name the root cause in one sentence

style_hints.claude: structured XML: cause, fix, corrected snippet
style_hints.gpt: numbered steps: 1. cause 2. fix 3. corrected code
style_hints.kimi: fix first, cause second — no preamble

tasks.baseline: Explain in detail why the following Python error occurred, what the root cause is, and provide a concrete fix with the corrected code. Include the full corrected snippet. {{input}}
tasks.input:
TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for -=: 'str' and 'int'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'app.py', line 12, in transfer
    accounts[src] -= amount
accounts = {'alice': '100', 'bob': 50}
amount = 25

tasks.name: deploy-check

intent.goal: Check this code for production readiness before deployment.
constraints: check error handling, secrets, logging, input validation

outputs.format: checklist with status and one-line finding per item

style_hints.claude: XML checklist with structured finding elements
style_hints.gpt: markdown checklist table: category | status | finding

tasks.baseline: Perform a pre-deployment review of the following code. Check for: missing error handling, hardcoded secrets or credentials, logging gaps, performance issues, and missing input validation. Provide a checklist with PASS/FAIL/WARN for each category and a brief explanation. {{code}}

tasks.name: dependency-audit

intent.goal: Audit these Python dependencies for security and maintenance risks.
constraints: flag known CVEs or pinned-low versions

outputs.format: risk table: package | version | risk | recommended action

style_hints.claude: XML risk assessment with structured package elements
style_hints.gpt: markdown risk table with upgrade recommendations
style_hints.kimi: concise risk list, highest risk first

tasks.baseline: Audit the following Python requirements for security vulnerabilities, outdated packages, and maintenance risks. For each package, check for known CVEs, note if the package appears unmaintained or deprecated, and provide a recommended action (upgrade/replace/ok). Rank by risk level. {{input}}

tasks.name: api-review

intent.goal: Review this API endpoint design for REST conventions and security gaps.
constraints: check HTTP method, status codes, auth, error responses

outputs.format: issue list with severity, description, and fix

style_hints.claude: XML structured issues with severity attributes
style_hints.gpt: markdown issue table: issue | severity | fix

tasks.baseline: Review the following API endpoint design for REST conventions, proper HTTP methods, appropriate status codes, authentication and authorization gaps, and error handling. List all issues found with severity and a concrete suggestion for improvement. {{input}}

tasks.name: commit-message

intent.goal: Write a conventional commit message for this git diff.

style_hints.claude: structured with subject, body, and breaking-change note if applicable
style_hints.gpt: conventional format with a one-paragraph body explaining the why
style_hints.kimi: subject only if simple; add body only if change is complex

tasks.baseline: Write a git commit message in Conventional Commits format for the following diff. The subject line should be under 72 characters, use the correct type prefix (feat/fix/refactor/docs/test/chore), and be in the imperative mood. Include a body paragraph if the change is complex or needs context. {{input}}

@@ -14,6 +14,9 @@ def create_alias(conn, petname, intent, scope='user'):
     """Mint identity, sign intent, bind petname in one transaction."""
+    existing = resolve(conn, petname, scope)
+    if existing:
+        raise PetnameExists(f"petname '{petname}' already exists in scope '{scope}'")

     cid, priv, pub = mint_key_identity()

tasks.name: security-audit

intent.goal: Perform a security audit of this code.

outputs.format: findings with CWE, severity (CVSS-level), and remediation

style_hints.claude: XML findings with CWE and CVSS score attributes
style_hints.gpt: markdown table: CWE | severity | description | remediation

tasks.baseline: Conduct a thorough and detailed security audit of the following code. Identify every exploitable vulnerability you can find, map each one to its corresponding CWE identifier, rank them all by severity from critical to low, and provide a remediation recommendation for each. {{code}}
